newsitem.title: USA: Pioneer Hi-Bred, CuraGen in alliance.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer Hi-Bred, CuraGen in alliance.

text.p: Pioneer Hi-Bred International Inc and CuraGen Corp said Tuesday they signed a collaboration agreement under which Pioneer will use CuraGen's proprietary gene expression technology.
Pioneer will apply the technology to discover genes responsible for agricultural seed product performance, the companies said.
In exchange, Pioneer will make a $7.5 million equity investment in CuraGen and will fund research at CuraGen over five years.

Pioneer will have worldwide development and marketing rights for seed and agricultural products, while CuraGen will retain rights for human and animal health applications, the companies said. Each company will receive royalties on the sale of licensed products developed by the other.
CuraGen is a genomics company, and Pioneer is a supplier of agricultural genetics.
